motion.name: dock-proximity
motion.value: scale 1 → 1.12 → 1 over -100px → 0 → 100px; spring mass 0.8, stiffness 300, damping 32
motion.purpose: Pointer response for icons only; disabled with coarse pointer or reduced motion.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Sky Blue action with dark readable labels.
components.css: .ds-button-primary{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.5rem;min-height:2.75rem;padding:.625rem 1rem;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:9px;font-size:.8125rem;font-weight:600;line-height:1.4;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 160ms ease-out,color 160ms ease-out;background:var(--accent);color:var(--on-brand);}.ds-button-primary:hover{background:#35a7d0;}.ds-button-primary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus, #9f216a);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-button-primary:active{transform:scale(.96);transition:none;}.ds-button-primary:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:not-allowed;transform:none;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button-primary{transition:none;}.ds-button-primary:active{transform:none;}}

components.name: Download document

components.name: Text field
components.css: .ds-field{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;display:block;color:#4c5059;font-size:.8125rem;font-weight:500;}.ds-field input{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;display:block;width:100%;min-height:2.75rem;margin-top:.375rem;padding:.6875rem .75rem;border:1px solid #aeb1bb;border-radius:8px;background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink);font-size:.875rem;}.ds-field input::placeholder{color:#686c75;opacity:1;}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus, #9f216a);outline-offset:3px;}

components.name: Document surface
components.css: .ds-card{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;padding:1.75rem;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink);font-size:.875rem;line-height:1.55;}.ds-card h2{margin:0 0 1rem;font-size:1.25rem;font-weight:650;line-height:1.25;letter-spacing:-.025em;}.ds-card p{max-width:72ch;}

components.name: Destination filter
components.description: Outlined filter with explicit pressed state.
components.css: .ds-filter{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.5rem;min-height:2.75rem;padding:.625rem 1rem;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:9px;font-size:.8125rem;font-weight:600;line-height:1.4;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 160ms ease-out,color 160ms ease-out;min-height:2.5rem;padding:.5rem .75rem;background:transparent;color:var(--muted);border-color:var(--line);font-weight:500;}.ds-filter[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--accent-soft);color:#076385;border-color:#b9d4f4;}.ds-filter:hover{background:#e9ebf0;color:var(--ink);}.ds-filter:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus, #9f216a);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-filter:active{transform:scale(.96);}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-filter{transition:none;}.ds-filter:active{transform:none;}}

narrative.overview:
A calm document workspace: a solid Sky Blue header gives the application a clear identity, while White work surfaces and dark blue ink keep attention on evidence and the next review action. Native system typography and familiar grouped controls preserve the confirmed Apple-inspired direction.

Density comes from compact labelled navigation and coherent document groups, with a pale blue decision area. Hot Pink marks active icons, selected sections and the first downloadable document action. Restrained motion responds to pointer proximity without moving link targets.
keyCharacteristics: White canvas and bordered document surfaces.
Sky Blue identity, selective Hot Pink accents and explicit semantic status colors.
Compact labelled navigation and persistent focus feedback.
Responsive document groups with readable evidence.

rules.name: The Brand Pairing Rule
rules.body: Keep Sky Blue and Hot Pink visible in their established roles; use dark labels on their filled surfaces and darker tonal variants for text on White. Reserve green and red for explicit status or feedback.

rules.name: The Stable Target Rule
rules.body: Animate navigation icons while keeping their link targets and labels stable.

rules.name: The Functional Depth Rule
rules.body: Keep document surfaces and selected segments flat; use depth for navigation separation and the document editor.

dos: Do use the confirmed Sky Blue, White and Hot Pink identity with the shared dark text pairings.
Do keep labels visible on navigation, using the shorter labels on compact screens.
Do preserve the visible keyboard focus ring and static reduced-motion and coarse-pointer navigation.
Do group document content and decisions with clear borders and tonal separation.
Do preserve factual warnings and visible fictional-demo identity while removing repeated page instructions.
donts: Don't add decorative backgrounds or marketing-scale headings to this task workspace.
Don't rely on hover to reveal essential evidence or navigation labels.
Don't scale navigation hit targets with the animated icons.
